name: url
label: URL
help: Enter a path relative to https://mcp.vstupenky.online, for example /make/v1/operations/context.inspect. This API exposes five authorized read operations only.

name: method
label: Method
help: The current read API supports POST; unsupported methods return HTTP 405.

name: headers
label: Headers
help: Supported additional headers: Accept, Content-Type and X-Request-ID. Authorization is supplied by the connection; authentication, host and pagination-control overrides are not forwarded.

name: body
label: Body
help: JSON object matching the canonical operation input. POST is the only transport method.
